name: io.github.Servosity/connectwise-rmm-mcp
title: ConnectWise RMM MCP
description: ConnectWise RMM (Asio) MCP: offline agents, patch posture, and script runs across every client.

environmentVariables.name: CONNECTWISE_RMM_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: ConnectWise RMM (Asio) API client ID from Integrations > API Access in the ConnectWise portal. Its prefix picks the region (0e30 North America, 0e31 Europe, 0e32 Australia).

environmentVariables.name: CONNECTWISE_RMM_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client secret paired with the API client ID. The connector exchanges the pair for a short-lived bearer token.

environmentVariables.name: CONNECTWISE_RMM_OAUTH_SCOPE
environmentVariables.description: Space-separated scopes to request. Leave blank to request every scope the connector uses; if your API key lacks one, the whole token request fails, so paste the line `connectwise-rmm-cli scopes` prints.

environmentVariables.name: CONNECTWISE_RMM_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Leave blank to follow the client ID's region (NA openapi.service.itsupport247.net, EU openapi.service.euplatform.connectwise.com, AU openapi.service.auplatform.connectwise.com). Set it only to pin a different host.

environmentVariables.name: CONNECTWISE_RMM_TOKEN_URL
environmentVariables.description: Leave blank to mint tokens at <base URL>/v1/token for your region. Set it only if ConnectWise gives you a different token endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: CONNECTWISE_RMM_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on ConnectWise RMM requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own.

environmentVariables.name: CONNECTWISE_RMM_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to make the MCP server read-only: it drops its write tools (run, sync; import is never an MCP tool) and refuses any non-GET API call. Leave blank for the full tool set.

environmentVariables.name: CONNECTWISE_RMM_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote or hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Leave blank. This connector registers no tenant-gated profile source, so the value is read but changes nothing; one MCP server serves the one API key it is given.
